whatIsIt.eli5: Brings three map sizes to the middle size and stacks them.
whatIsIt.simple: Average-pools P3 down by 2, upsamples P5 by 2, joins them with P4 and mixes with a 1×1 Conv.

whyExists.eli5: The group finder needs all sizes together.
whyExists.simple: HyperACE treats pixels from all three scales as vertices of one hypergraph.

engineer: channel_adjust=False (l/x) when the three widths are equal: 3·c_in input.
